about: Maximum SV weight of each dated milestone, read by hand from the weight_earned text in cip_milestones.json (CIP texts at canton-foundation/cips 92df641). Only grants with escrowed weight on 2026-11-01 are listed, plus CIP-0125 (Paxos), whose escrow takes effect on 2026-11-12. Undated milestones are omitted. 'Max +2' and 'up to +3' are recorded as their maximum. CIP-0113 milestones are +0.5 infrastructure plus up to +1.5 activity each (2.0; 4 x 2.0 = the CIP's total of 8).

extensions.CIP-0060: CIP-0099 (approved 2026-01-07) moved Zero Hash's adoption incentives (D4a-c) to start on 2026-04-01 and run for up to 24 months.
